name: Super-heavy Walker
summary: When this unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, its models can move through models (not Titanic) and horizontally through terrain up to 4" tall. You can give them Mobile for it; roll a D6 at the end, battle-shocked on a 1.

name: Agent of Discord
summary: Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit within 12" of this model with a Stratagem, you can increase that Stratagem's CP cost by 1.

name: Agent of Discord (Aura)
summary: Enemy Stratagems used to target a unit within 12" of this model cost 1 extra CP; this increase does not stack with similar effects.

name: Airborne Predator
summary: Each time this model makes a ranged attack that targets a unit that can FLY, add 1 to the Hit roll.

name: Architect of Ruin
summary: At the start of the battle, select one unit in your opponent's army to be this model's hated foe. Each time this model makes an attack that targets its hated foe, you can re-roll the Wound roll. Each time this model's hated foe is destroyed, you can select a new unit from your opponent's army to be its hated foe.

name: Ascended Daemon
summary: Each time this model shoots or fights, you can re-roll one Hit roll and one Wound roll made for it.

name: Aspire to Glory
summary: Each time this model's unit makes a Dark Pact, this model's weapons gain +D3 Strength until the end of the phase.

name: Atomantic Arc-reactor
summary: If the bearer's unit Remained Stationary this turn, one of its ranged weapons gains the Lethal Hits ability when it shoots that turn.

name: Blood Surge
summary: In your opponent's Shooting phase, if a model in this unit was destroyed by an enemy unit's attacks, this unit can make a surge move of up to D6+2".

name: Bringers of Change
summary: Ranged attacks from this unit re-roll a Wound roll of 1, or any Wound roll if the target is within range of an objective marker you do not control.

name: Brutal Raider
summary: After this model's unit ends a Charge move, its melee weapons gain +1 Strength and +1 Armour Penetration until the end of the turn.

name: Chirurgeon
summary: The first time this unit's FABIUS BILE model is destroyed, at the end of the phase roll one D6: on a 2+, return it to the battlefield near where it fell (outside Engagement Range) with full wounds.

name: Choice Samples
summary: While this unit's Garreon the Corpsemaster is on the battlefield, in your Command phase, select one of the following: return 1 destroyed model (excluding CHARACTER models) to this unit; or, if one or more Heretic Astartes Infantry units from your army are below Starting Strength and within 3" of this unit, gain 1CP.

name: Corrupt Machine Spirits
summary: At the start of your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy Vehicle unit within 12" and roll a D6: on 2-3 it suffers D3 mortal wounds, on 4-5 it suffers 3, and on a 6 it suffers D3+3.

name: Crushing Charge
summary: This unit can re-roll Charge rolls, and after it charges, the charged enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds for each engaged model that rolls 4+ on a die.

name: CULT OF DESTRUCTION
summary: For working out Transport capacity used, each model with this ability counts as one Obliterator model.

name: Daemonforge
summary: Each time this unit makes a Dark Pact, until the end of the phase this model's attacks re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

name: Daemonic Destruction
summary: Each time this model ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it and roll one D6 for each of this model's remaining wounds. For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound, to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds.

name: Daemonic Ordnance
summary: Each time this model is selected to shoot, it can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, its ranged weapons have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] and [HAZARDOUS] abilities.

name: Dark Ascension (Aura)
summary: While a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES unit is within 6" of this model, each time that unit makes a Dark Pact, until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in that unit gain both abilities conferred by that pact (instead of only one).

name: Dark Blessing (Aura)
summary: While a friendly Heretic Astartes Infantry unit is within 6" of this model, each time a ranged attack is allocated to a model in that unit, that model has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

name: Dark Champion
summary: While attached to a unit, models in that unit gain +1 to their Hit rolls.

name: Dark Destiny
summary: Each time this model's unit makes a Dark Pact and passes the Leadership roll with a 7+, you gain 1CP.

name: Death Frenzy
summary: When a model in this unit that has not yet fought is destroyed in melee, roll a die: on a 4+ it still fights before being removed from play.

name: Deredeo Strike
summary: Ranged attacks from this model against a target that is not Below Half-strength can re-roll the Hit roll.

name: Dreadclaw Assault
summary: This model must start the battle in Reserves. Neither it nor any units embarked within it count towards any limits on the maximum number of Reserves units you can start the battle with. It can be set up in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules. Any units embarked within it can disembark after it has been set up on the battlefield; if they do, they must be set up more than 9" away from all enemy models.

name: Enhanced Warriors
summary: If this unit is attached to a unit at the start of the battle, then until the end of the battle, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by Bodyguard models in that unit, and add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of Bodyguard models in that unit.

name: Enrage Machine Spirits
summary: At the end of your Movement phase, force one enemy Vehicle unit within 12" to take a Battle-shock test.

name: Even In Death I Serve
summary: The first time this model is destroyed, it is removed without triggering its Deadly Demise; at the end of the phase, a 2+ roll returns it with D6 wounds remaining.

name: Explorator Augury Web
summary: Enemy Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of the bearer, but the bearer's Transport capacity is halved.

name: Fleet Command
summary: After both players have deployed their armies, if this unit is on the battlefield (or any Transport it is embarked within is on the battlefield), select up to three HERETIC ASTARTES units from your army and redeploy them. When redeploying, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

name: Flying Horror
summary: After this model moves over an enemy unit during a Normal or Advance move, that unit must take a Battle-shock test.

name: Guns Blazing
summary: Once per turn, in your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit makes a ranged attack that targets a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES unit within 3" of this model, after that enemy unit has shot, this model can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase. It must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

name: Hamadrya's Knowledge (Psychic)
summary: Once per battle round, when an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 8" of this model's unit, that unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+3", provided it is not within Engagement Range of any enemy unit.

name: Head Taker
summary: While attached to a unit, after that unit ends a Charge move, roll one die per engaged model: each 4+ deals 1 mortal wound to the charged enemy unit.

name: Headlong Destruction
summary: Attacks from this unit that target the closest eligible enemy unit gain +1 Armour Penetration.

name: Herald of the Apocalypse (Aura)
summary: During your opponent's Battle-shock step, an enemy unit within 6" that is below its Starting Strength must take a Battle-shock test, at most once per phase.

name: Hovering Death
summary: This model is eligible to shoot and to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

name: Icon of Despair (Aura)
summary: Enemy units within 6" of the bearer have their Leadership worsened by 1.

name: Icon of Flame
summary: Ranged weapons of models in the bearer's unit, excluding Characters, gain the Ignores Cover ability.

name: Icon of Khorne
summary: Destroying an enemy unit while this unit carries the icon earns a Bloodshed point; a Blessings of Khorne roll gets one bonus die per accumulated point, then the points are spent.

name: Impaled
summary: A hit from this weapon against an enemy Monster or Vehicle lets the bearer add 2 to Charge rolls against that unit for the rest of the turn.

name: Indentured Daemon Engines
summary: While within 3" of a friendly Daemon Vehicle unit, this model has the Lone Operative ability.

name: Infernal Regeneration
summary: The first time this model is destroyed, it is removed from play and its Deadly Demise ability is not resolved. At the end of that phase, roll one D6: on a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with D6 wounds remaining.

name: Infused with the Blessings of Nurgle
summary: After this unit shoots, one enemy unit it hit becomes Afflicted until the start of your next turn.

name: Inviolable Transport
summary: Once per battle round, an attack allocated to this model can have its Damage characteristic changed to 0.

name: Kharybdis Assault
summary: This transport starts in Reserves without counting against reserve limits and can arrive by the third Movement phase; units disembarking from it must end more than 9" from all enemy models.

name: Khorne
summary: This model's hellforged weapons gain +2 Strength.

name: Lord of Badab (Aura)
summary: Aura. While a friendly Heretic Astartes Infantry unit is within 6" of this model, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit. Battle-shocked units and Damned units are excluded.

name: Lord of the Traitor Legions (Aura)
summary: While a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding DAMNED units) is within 6" of this model, you can re-roll Leadership and Battle-shock tests taken for that unit.

name: Malevolent Locus (Aura)
summary: Aura. While a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES model is wholly within 9" of this FORTIFICATION, improve that unit's Leadership characteristic by 1.

name: Malign Cover
summary: A model that is not fully visible to the attacking unit because of this fortification has the Benefit of Cover against that ranged attack.

name: Mark of Chaos Ascendant (Aura)
summary: Aura. While a friendly Heretic Astartes Infantry or Heretic Astartes Mounted unit (excluding DAMNED units) is within 6" of this model, models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

name: Master of Mechanisms
summary: In your Command phase, select one friendly Heretic Astartes Vehicle model within 3" of this model. That VEHICLE model regains up to D3 lost wounds, and until the start of your next Command phase, each time that VEHICLE makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. Each model can only be selected for this ability once per Command phase.

name: MASTERS OF THE MAELSTROM
summary: During the Declare Battle Formations step, this unit can merge into one of several named units, increasing that unit's Starting Strength; it cannot join an Attached unit.

name: Mind-breaking Mutations (Aura)
summary: Enemy units, excluding Vehicles, within 3" have their Objective Control reduced by 1.

name: Nurgle
summary: This model gains +1 Toughness.

name: Outmanoeuvre
summary: Melee attacks from this unit gain +1 Strength if it made a Charge move this turn.

name: Paragon of Hatred (Aura)
summary: While a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES unit, excluding DAMNED units, is within 6" of this model, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

name: Plough Through the Enemy
summary: After this model fights, if it destroyed an enemy unit that phase, every enemy unit within 6" must take a Battle-shock test.

name: Plunder
summary: Once per battle, after this unit moves, target a visible enemy unit within 12": on a 2+ roll it suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.

name: Raider's Due
summary: When this unit charges an enemy unit within 12" that is within range of an objective, it can re-roll the charge roll but must end that move engaged with one of those enemy units.

name: Reorder Reality
summary: Enemy units within 18" that target this model with an attack suffer -1 to Hit, and their ranged weapons gain the Hazardous ability until the end of the phase.

name: Runes of the Blood God
summary: This model has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds and Psychic Attacks.

name: Scuttling Gait
summary: Instead of rolling to Advance, this unit's Move characteristic simply increases by 6" until the end of the phase.

name: Siege Crawler
summary: This model can ignore any modifiers applied to its Move characteristic or to its Advance and Charge rolls.

name: Slaanesh
summary: This model's Move characteristic increases by 2".

name: Soul Eater
summary: If this model's attacks destroy an enemy unit during the Fight phase, its weapons permanently gain +1 Attacks for the rest of the battle.

name: Spirit Thief
summary: At the start of your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy VEHICLE unit. Until the end of that phase, each time a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES model makes an attack targeting that unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

name: Super-heavy Walker
summary: Each time this model makes a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move, it can move over non-TITANIC models and terrain up to 4" tall as if they were not there.

name: Surgeon Acolyte
summary: Once per turn, while this unit contains its named character, an attack allocated to a model in the unit can have its Damage changed to 0.

name: Swift Assault
summary: While attached to a unit, ranged weapons of models in that unit gain the Assault ability.

name: Terrifying Crescendo
summary: After this unit shoots, one enemy unit it hit suffers -1 to Battle-shock and Leadership tests until the start of your next Shooting phase.

name: The Warmaster
summary: In your Command phase, choose one of several listed Warmaster abilities for this model to have until your next Command phase.

name: Trophy Taker
summary: Each time this model destroys an enemy Character model, gain 1CP.

name: Trophy Takers
summary: The first time this unit destroys an enemy unit, it permanently gains +1 Objective Control while not Battle-shocked.

name: Tzeentch
summary: Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of its infernal cannon.

name: Unholy Mechanisms (Aura)
summary: Friendly Daemon Vehicle units within 6" have their weapons' Strength increased by 2.

name: Unholy Power
summary: After this model's unit makes a Dark Pact, this model's Psychic Attacks gain +1 to the Wound roll until the end of the phase.

name: Visions of Suffering (Psychic)
summary: Attacks from this unit against a depleted enemy unit gain +1 to Hit, and +1 to Wound as well if that unit is Below Half-strength.

name: Voice Eater
summary: Enemy units, excluding Monsters and Vehicles, within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit cannot be targeted by Stratagems.

name: Warp Rift Firepower
summary: Once per battle, this unit's ranged weapons gain the Indirect Fire ability for the Shooting phase.

name: Warp-sighted Butcher
summary: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If that target unit is Below Half-strength, you can also re-roll the Wound roll.

name: Warpsmith
summary: While within 3" of a friendly Heretic Astartes Vehicle unit, this model has the Lone Operative ability.

name: Blessings of Khorne
summary: At the start of the battle round, roll 8D6 to activate up to two Blessings of Khorne (each needs matching dice) for WORLD EATERS units until round end, each granting a combat bonus (e.g. bonus charge, Sustained Hits, Devastating Wounds).

name: Cabal of Sorcerers (Aspiring Sorcerer only)
summary: Shooting phase start: each model with this ability may attempt one Ritual per turn, each Ritual once per turn. Roll 2D6, optionally Channelling the Warp; any double or triple costs its unit D3 mortal wounds; total must meet the Warp Charge.

name: Nurgle's Gift (Aura)
summary: Enemy units within Contagion Range (max 12") of your Death Guard models are Afflicted: -1 Toughness, plus the Plague you chose at deployment - -1 to their melee Hit rolls, or -1 Save, or -1 Move, Leadership and Objective Control.

name: Thrill Seekers
summary: If your Army Faction is Emperor's Children, this unit can shoot and charge in a turn it Advanced or Fell Back, but cannot target a unit it was engaged with at the start of the turn, or one another unit has charged or attacked this phase.
